title: Life expectancy at birth, by dog breed

source.name: Life tables of annual life expectancy of UK companion dogs
source.publisher: VetCompass (Royal Veterinary College) / Scientific Reports (Teng et al. 2022)

notes: Life expectancy at birth from VetCompass's UK dog life-table study. Researchers note the French Bulldog figure is pulled down by the breed's very recent surge of young dogs in the population. Rounded to one decimal.
